source: Each key is a type-descriptor code name (pylabview's TD_FULL_TYPE; the numbering is OpenG's 'Type Descriptor Enumeration__ogtk.ctl' and NI's 'Type Descriptors' page). Each value is the label of the item of NI's 'Data Type.ctl' enum (NI_Data Type.lvlib), the enum the Type output of Get Type Information.vi carries (its items are read from the caller's recorded type of that terminal; the labels are those items). A native LabVIEW variant is 'LV Variant' and an OLE variant 'Variant' (NI forum, 'Get the type of the data in a variant', forums.ni.com/t5/LabVIEW/Get-the-type-of-the-data-in-a-variant/td-p/4264589 and 'How to Get OLE Variant Type?', td-p/1334434). A code that names several items by itself is NOT listed: MeasureData (Waveform, Timestamp, Digital Waveform, Digital Data, ExpressData), Refnum (Refnum, VI, LabVIEW Class Instance) and Function. A code with no entry makes the node raise where it runs, naming the code.
representations_source: Each key is a type-descriptor code name; each value is the label of the item of LVNumericRepresentation.ctl that the Representation output of Get Numeric Information.vi returns for it (read from the caller's recorded type of that terminal). The labels are LabVIEW's own names of the representations: Long (I32), Word (I16), Byte (I8), Quad (I64), the Unsigned forms, Single/Double/Extended Precision (SGL/DBL/EXT) and Complex Single/Double/Extended. An enum is stored as an unsigned integer of its width. A code not listed (a number with a unit, fixed-point) is not read.
refnum_types_source: Each key is a refnum kind (a name of pylabview's REFNUM_TYPE); each value is the label of the item of the Refnum Type enum that the Reference Type output of Get Refnum Information.vi carries (read from the caller's recorded type of that terminal: NotARefnum, UnknownRefnum, Generic, Datalog, ByteStream, Device, Occurence, TCPNetConnection, Auto, Menu, Imaq, Hardware, DataSocket, Visa, IVI, UDPNetConnection, Notifier, Queue, Irda, EventReg, DotNet, UserEvent, Callback, UNUSED_EMPTY_POSITION, BlueToothNetConnection, LVObjApp, LVObjVI, LVObjUnknown, GenericClass, UserDefinedRefnumTag, DataValue, RT FIFO, TDMS File). A kind is listed only where its name and the item's name are the same word (TCPNetConn / TCPNetConnection, NotifierRef / Notifier, FIFORef / RT FIFO); a kind with no such item (the unused codes, UsrDefined, UsrDefTagFlt, LabVIEW class instances) and a generic VI Server reference that is neither an Application nor a VI reference are not listed, and the node raises where it runs.
refnum_server_classes_source: A generic reference (LVObjCtl) records its VI Server class in its type's CtlFlags (0x0001 an Application, 0x0002 a VI: the first two items of the VI Server Generic Type enum, kLVObjApp=0x1 and kLVObjVI). Each key is that class; each value is the label of the Refnum Type item for it.
